beats: My task generator built homework from memory and weak spots — never checking what classes were studying that week.
Homework should match what's taught in class, for each subject, for every kid.
Like teaching last year's lesson plan while the real class moved on.
Now a nightly Cloudflare Workers routine reads the real curriculum and builds each day's practice from that week's unit.
It's built from 634 real lesson units across three subjects and nine grades, matched to every child.
